name: Exterior Porch Ceiling RP Surface Preparation
intent: RP prep — wash, mildew biocide, scrape/feather (condition-driven), degloss/scuff, caulk repair, dust cleanup. No chalk remediation (chalk washed off, then standard prime).
doctrine: RP prep. Condition modifier (GOOD:1.0, FAIR:1.5, POOR:2.0) on scrape/feather. RRP modifier (2.0x) stacks on scrape/feather. Panel joints modifier on degloss/scuff. No chalk remediation — chalk washed off during low-pressure wash, then standard acrylic prime. Mildew biocide is conditional on presence. All overhead rates baked in.
